title: Application menu · About navigation
expect: Start in Auto Backup settings, then select a different category before invoking the application menu.

actions.action: Choose About BackupDuck from the application menu.
actions.result: Settings selects About and shows its actual content, even if another detail was already open.

actions.action: Repeat from Backup and from another Settings category.
actions.result: About opens each time, including after Settings was removed from the view hierarchy.
